science: Accepted Euphorbia ophthalmica Pers. POWO/FNA; E. hirta often taller and has both terminal and axillary cyathium heads, ophthalmica densely terminal on main stems or short LEAFY branch tips; both hairy capsules, so smooth-fruit assumption avoided. Hypericifolia glabrous and has glabrous fruit. No Hays native-zone classification changed.
verified_image_arrows: Real saved photographed pixels manually inspected; 12 arrows target heads, prostrate stems, leaf hair, leaf teeth and opposite attachments only. No arrows to unconfirmed capsule hairs, tiny stipule segments or seeds.
